preconditions.description: The input s is a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c.isdigit() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string contains only lowercase letters and digits.
Numbers in the string do not have leading zeros (as stated in the problem).

postconditions.expression: return_value == max((int(''.join(group)) for group in (c for c in s if c.isdigit() or c.islower()), key=lambda x: x) if any(c.isdigit() for c in s) else 0)
postconditions.description: The return value is the largest integer formed by consecutive digit groupings in the string; if no digits exist, it returns 0.
The return value is an integer.
